Staatsblad 2022 No. 121: Wet Belasting over de Toegevoegde Waarde 2022 — 10% from 1 January 2023, 25% on annex-3 luxury goods, replacing the Wet Omzetbelasting 1997
Communicatiedienst Suriname: BTW in werking per 1 januari 2023 — general rate 10%, 5% on gasoline, 25% on luxury goods; turnover tax was 12%

caveats: individualTaxYear is the calendar year, inferred from the country's annual assessment cycle (grade I); not confirmed on the authority's own pages in this pass.
companyYearEndDefault is a 31 December app default for new entities (grade I), not a statutory requirement; companies may choose other year ends under national law.

Suriname replaced its 12% turnover tax with a 10% VAT on 1 January 2023 (Staatsblad 2022 No. 121); 0% applies to basic necessities, exports, and oil, gas and mining supplies (zero-rate rows not modelled).
